name: Secondary-offering discount recovery
hypothesis: Buy after verified terms, selling stabilization, and a reclaim of a preregistered event reference.
spec: Setup: A public offering price may become a temporary reference during price discovery. Entry: Buy after verified terms, selling stabilization, and a reclaim of a preregistered event reference. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit below the stabilization low or at the session deadline. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs primary filings / corporate-event data with receipt times (licensed feed)
